reviewed_by: Claude review of browserd tab lifecycle and companion failure paths
reason: Five verified defects in the browser backend. (3) browserd registered pages once and only hooked context close, so a tab the operator closed from the headed Chromium window (or window.close()) stayed in _tabs and site-opened popups were never registered; the companion tabs listing then called page.title() on the dead page, which raises, so tabs/new_tab/close_tab and BrowserCompanion.open() all failed with 500 until the whole context was closed. browserd now registers page close (evicting every key for that page) and context page (registering popups idempotently), ensure_identity skips and evicts is_closed() pages, and operate() skips closed pages and reuses the manager's id for new_page. (6) BrowserCompanion.request() ran its pre-flight tabs call outside the httpx error mapping, so a slow or wedged browserd surfaced as a raw ConnectError/ReadTimeout/HTTPStatusError instead of the sanitized reconnect/retry guidance; both calls now go through one _companion_call helper. (7) Assessment stop/complete/revoke required a READY managed-chromium adapter, so a DRAFT created while Chromium was missing could never be revoked and a RUNNING assessment whose browserd died could only be failed; the adapter is now required only for start/pause/resume and the engine stop is best-effort (skipped when absent or when the assessment never started). (8) decide() set the action to running and only except Exception restored a terminal state, so a cancelled chat turn left it running forever; it now catches BaseException, and invalidate_pending_actions also sweeps running rows whose turn ended or whose approval window lapsed by more than two companion budgets. (10) The /v1/actions client deadline was 5 s while browserd runs Playwright's 30 s defaults, so any slower action fabricated an ambiguous receipt; the deadline is now derived from BROWSER_ACTION_TIMEOUT_SECONDS like the companion path. New tests: test_closed_tabs_are_forgotten_and_popups_are_listed (browserd fake Playwright; fails on main with the closed-page title error), test_preflight_tab_check_failure_is_sanitized_like_the_operation x4 (raw httpx errors on main), test_cancelled_decision_leaves_a_terminal_action and test_invalidating_approvals_sweeps_stale_running_actions_only (running on main), test_stop_and_revoke_do_not_require_managed_chromium (unavailable error on main), test_action_client_deadline_covers_playwright_operation_timeout (5 s on main). The rest of the four files pins the surrounding companion, assessment and engine behaviour.
exclusions: No frontend tests: no ui/ change. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: area:core-api (the real-Core journey suite matched through browserd.py, browser_companion.py, browser_companion_runtime.py, browser_assessments.py and browser_engine.py) does not exercise operator-closed Chromium tabs, browserd transport failures, engine-absent assessment transitions, cancelled decisions or the action client deadline; the Python tests drive them directly with fakes. No full suites. python_browser is set because test_browser_companion.py includes a real-Chromium capture case.
